Atrium Fixture (game header)

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_fixture.Rd

One game's header: teams, score, venue, status, rules (periods, overtime, shot clock) and captains.

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/fixture_detail?sub=statistics

The rules (number_of_periods, period_length in minutes, overtime_length, shot_clock in seconds, ...) come from the game's profile. *_captain_person_id is the person id of each team's captain.

Usage

atrium_fixture(website_id, fixture_id, locale = NULL)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

fixture_id

(character required): Game UUID (fixture_id in atrium_fixtures()), e.g. "0dc631bd-c34c-11f1-8d16-4d5a21afb79d".

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row for the game:

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
fixture_idcharacterGame UUID (fixture); the key of every game frame and of the fixture_detail routes.
season_idcharacterSeason UUID of the game.
competition_namecharacterName of the competition, in the site's language.
namecharacterFixture name; null on LNBP.
fixture_typecharacterKind of game as sent: REGULAR, PLAYOFF, ... (the set is open).
age_groupcharacterAge group of the competition, e.g. SENIOR.
statuscharacterStatus code of the game, e.g. CONFIRMED (final), as sent.
status_labelcharacterStatus of the game as the site words it in its own language (e.g. Termine, Final).
start_time_utcPOSIXctScheduled start, naive datetime in UTC (the API sends no offset).
start_time_localcharacterScheduled start in the venue's local time, as the API sends it (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, no offset; timezone gives the zone, which varies per row).
timezonecharacterIANA time zone of the venue (e.g. Europe/Paris, Mexico/General) that start_time_local is in.
venuecharacterName of the arena where the game is played.
venue_idcharacterVenue UUID; joins no other route.
attendanceintegerSpectators at the game; null when not reported.
external_idcharacterThe league's own match number (LNB: the lnb.fr number); null elsewhere.
updatedPOSIXctWhen the record was last updated, naive datetime (no offset; zone unverified).
live_data_availablelogicalTrue when live data feeds are enabled for the game.
live_video_availablelogicalTrue when a live video stream is attached.
disciplinecharacterDiscipline label of the game; null in every body seen.
seriescharacterPlayoff series the game belongs to as sent (JSON text when an object); null outside a series.
number_of_periodsintegerRegulation periods in the game (4).
period_lengthintegerLength of a regulation period, in minutes.
overtime_allowedlogicalTrue when the game may go to overtime.
overtime_lengthintegerLength of an overtime period, in minutes.
shot_clockintegerShot clock length, in seconds.
max_fouls_personalintegerPersonal fouls that disqualify a player.
fouls_before_bonusintegerTeam fouls in a period before the bonus applies.
maximum_players_on_courtintegerPlayers a team has on court at once.
maximum_roster_sizeintegerLargest roster a team may enter for the game.
home_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the home team.
home_codecharacterShort code of the home team (e.g. PAB).
home_namecharacterName of the home team.
home_scoreintegerPoints scored by the home team (the API sends a string; Int64 here).
home_result_statuscharacterResult status of the home team's score, e.g. CONFIRMED.
away_entity_idcharacterTeam UUID of the away team.
away_codecharacterShort code of the away team (e.g. PAB).
away_namecharacterName of the away team.
away_scoreintegerPoints scored by the away team (the API sends a string; Int64 here).
away_result_statuscharacterResult status of the away team's score, e.g. CONFIRMED.
home_captain_person_idcharacterPerson UUID of the home team's captain; null when the body names none.
away_captain_person_idcharacterPerson UUID of the away team's captain; null when the body names none.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in atrium_fixtures().
